spellbook.finance/limitations: An absent row falls through to a built-in collector-box hold rule, then open intent. The tool does not resolve one product's final rule.
Open intent is a plan to open, not proof that a box was physically opened or eligible for sale.

description: Read a workspace's future sealed-purchase open or hold defaults. Call this before changing how extension-captured products are classified. These rows affect future captures only; spellbook_sealed_portfolio reports marks already on physical units.

workspaceId.description: The workspace whose defaults to read. Required.

name: spellbook_sealed_intent_defaults
